lines.en: Start with one equation. x squared equals x plus one. Its positive root is the golden ratio, phi.
lines.zh: 从一个方程开始：x 的平方等于 x 加一。它的正根，就是黄金比 phi。

lines.en: This project grew a whole theory from it, and promised one thing: to walk six domains of mathematics, and mark honestly the two points it cannot reach.
lines.zh: 这个项目从它长出了一整套理论，并承诺了一件事：走遍数学的六个疆域，并诚实标出它到不了的两个点。

lines.en: Its central claim is about coordinates. A good coordinate system is the frame that stays fixed when the structure acts on itself.
lines.zh: 它的核心主张关于坐标。好的坐标系，是结构作用于自身时保持不动的那个标架。

lines.en: Golden Invariant Coordinate Theory. Not a claim that the universe runs on phi. A claim about how to read.
lines.zh: 黄金不动坐标理论。它不主张宇宙以 phi 运行。它主张的是：如何读。

lines.en: Every number gets three readings. Scale: which power of phi it sits between. Digits: its unique Zeckendorf sum of Fibonacci numbers. Phase: where n times phi lands on a circle.
lines.zh: 每个数得到三种读法。尺度：它落在 phi 的哪两个幂之间。数位：它唯一的 Zeckendorf 斐波那契和。相位：n 乘 phi 落在圆上的哪里。

lines.en: Drop thirteen points at steps of phi around a circle. They cut it into gaps of exactly two lengths. Root two, e and pi each leave three.
lines.zh: 以 phi 为步长，在圆上放十三个点。它们把圆切成恰好两种长度的间隙。根号二、e 和 pi，都留下三种。

lines.en: Why phi? Because it is the number hardest to approximate by fractions. Its continued fraction is all ones.
lines.zh: 为什么是 phi？因为它是最难被分数逼近的数。它的连分数全是一。

lines.en: So its points never clump. The theory says it in one line: the most continuous number and the most discrete ruler are two faces of the same extreme.
lines.zh: 所以它的点永远不会结块。理论用一句话说：最连续的数与最离散的尺，是同一个极值的两面。

lines.en: Its arithmetic has a surname: five. A prime stays prime in the golden integers exactly when it leaves remainder two or three after division by five. Proved in Lean.
lines.zh: 它的算术有一个姓氏：五。一个素数在黄金整数里仍然是素数，当且仅当它除以五余二或余三。在 Lean 中证明。

lines.en: And five is the smallest discriminant of any real quadratic field. The theory's verdict: five is the eldest son, not the father; phi is the champion, not the king.
lines.zh: 而五是最小的判别式。理论的判词：五是长子，不是父亲；phi 是冠军，不是国王。

lines.en: Slice a two-dimensional lattice with a line of slope phi, and read off a word of zeros and ones. Read in one dimension, it looks disordered. It contains cubes, but never a fourth power, kernel-checked.
lines.zh: 用一条斜率为 phi 的直线切二维格点，读出一串零和一。在一维里读，它看起来是无序的。它含有三次方，却永远没有四次方，经内核核验。

lines.en: Add one hidden coordinate, and every letter becomes a simple window test. The theory calls this decompression: dimension is a format for unpacking non-local information.
lines.zh: 加上一个隐藏的坐标，每一个字母都变成一个简单的窗口检验。理论称之为解压：维度，是非局域信息的解压格式。

lines.en: Now the fixed frame. The rule that grows this word is a two by two matrix. Its eigen-directions have factors phi and minus one over phi.
lines.zh: 现在是不动标架。生成这个词的规则，是一个二乘二矩阵。它的本征方向，因子分别是 phi 和负的 phi 分之一。

lines.en: One axis stretches, one axis flips sign. These two directions do not move when the rule acts. That is theorem seven point three: a good coordinate system is a fixed frame under transformation.
lines.zh: 一条轴伸缩，一条轴翻号。规则作用时，这两个方向不动。这就是定理七点三：好的坐标系，是变换下的不动标架。

lines.en: Why this equation? Take every rule that feeds x back into itself, with coefficients zero or one. There are exactly four fates.
lines.zh: 为什么是这个方程？取所有把 x 喂回自身、系数为零或一的规则。命运恰好只有四种。

lines.en: Empty. Dead, with no solution. Collapsed, returning after two steps. Or alive, never reaching the bottom. Only the phi family is alive. It was not chosen. It was what remained.
lines.zh: 空：什么都没发生。死：无解。塌：两步回到原地。或者活：代入自身，永不见底。只有 phi 家族是活的。它不是被挑中的，而是被剩下的。

lines.en: The theory measures its own constants, to eight digits or in closed form. One constant was read by five instruments at once, and matched fifty-seven minus twenty-five root five, over twenty-four.
lines.zh: 理论测量它自己的常数，精确到八位，或给出闭式。有一个常数由五台仪器同时读出，吻合二十四分之，五十七减二十五倍根号五。

lines.en: A cotangent sum almost equals minus one fifth, missing by three millionths. The volume logs that near miss as a trap, and gives the exact value instead.
lines.zh: 一个余切和几乎等于负五分之一，只差百万分之三。卷中把这个险些吻合登记为陷阱，并给出精确值。

lines.en: Here is the anti-numerology wall. The fine-structure constant can be written in powers of phi to eleven digits. So can a random number. So can it in powers of root two.
lines.zh: 这是防命理之墙。精细结构常数可以用 phi 的幂写到十一位。一个随机数也可以。用根号二的幂也可以。

lines.en: The alphabet can dress any number. The costume is not evidence. The theory does not claim the universe runs on phi. In physics, phi is selected, not written in.
lines.zh: 字母表能给任何数穿衣，衣服不是证据。理论不主张宇宙以 phi 运行。在物理中，phi 是被选出的，不是被写入的。

lines.en: It also kills its own conjectures. Nearly ten thousand cases supported one; then a single counterexample appeared at level four hundred sixty-eight, just outside the old search box.
lines.zh: 它也处决自己的猜想。近一万个案例支持过一个猜想；然后，一个反例出现在第四百六十八级，恰好在旧搜索框之外。

lines.en: The verdict: ten thousand cases with zero counterexamples was sampling bias. The lemmas survived; the universal claim died. And a golden fix for transformers gave a gain of exactly one: nothing.
lines.zh: 判词：近万例零反例，是采样偏倚。引理存活，全称命题死亡。而一个用于 transformer 的黄金修补，增益恰好是一倍：什么都没有。

lines.en: Some results went all the way to the kernel. Pick any fourteen speeds from one to twenty: there is a moment when every runner is at least one fifteenth of a lap from the start.
lines.zh: 有些结果一路走到了内核。从一到二十里任选十四个速度：总有一个时刻，每个跑者离起点都至少十五分之一圈。

lines.en: Every denominator up to one thousand twenty-four has a fraction with continued-fraction digits at most five. And on a thin seventeen by seventeen board, at most twenty-six points avoid three in a line. All frozen.
lines.zh: 一千零二十四以内的每个分母，都有一个连分数数字不超过五的分数。在一张十七乘十七的稀疏棋盘上，至多二十六个点能避免三点共线。全部冻结。

lines.en: Mathematics, the theory says, is not the largest fixed point. It is an endless ladder climbing toward one it cannot reach. The width of that gap is called incompleteness.
lines.zh: 理论说，数学不是最大的不动点。它是一架无尽的阶梯，攀向一个到不了的不动点。那道沟的宽度，叫作不完备性。

lines.en: The two points on the map are still unreached. This is not a record of failure. It is the progress of a survey.
lines.zh: 地图上的两个点，仍然没有抵达。这不是失败的记录，而是测绘的进度。
